name: Fomichev-Karev-Pavutnitskiy-Usanov conjecture: the sl(2) weight system at c = -3/32 extends to a graph 4-invariant (proved)
target: arXiv:2607.24217 Section 4: the specialization of the sl(2) weight system at c = -3/32 extends to a 4-invariant of graphs
result: True, with xi(G) = S_G(-2)/(-32)^n, S_G(N) the signed count of maps from the vertices to 2-subsets of [N]. Constructions: Verma modules of highest weights -1/2 and -3/2 realized in the oscillator representation, a supertrace with a Wick formula on the Weyl algebra, a Clifford-algebra trace at N generators, and an involution on assignments for the four-term relation.

notes.human: not yet refereed (European Journal of Combinatorics package ready)
